origin: gpt-oss candidate (focal-point ad hoc; Qwen comparison from lever_table)

paper-ready: with caveat: say post hoc and separate root

origin: gpt-oss candidate (moral-primes ad hoc; Qwen from lever_table)

claim: A collusion detector built on Qwen early-round quotes and frozen transfers to gpt-oss games; adding the frozen text model adds nothing.

main caveat: the label comes from the same quotes later in the game (early quotes predict late quotes), so this is a price-trajectory detector, not a ground-truth collusion detector; no hand labels
paper-ready: with caveat: rebuild on the final 819 games; state the label

claim: The frozen Qwen text detectors do not transfer: on gpt-oss headline chat they are near chance or miss almost everything at the frozen threshold.
